
══════════════════════════════════════════
  HUNT: Named Pipe C2 / Lateral Movement
══════════════════════════════════════════

  Scan detail:
    Committed memory regions scanned for '\pipe\' name strings (unscored lead only)

  VERDICT     HIGH CONFIDENCE C2 PIPE / LATERAL MOVEMENT — handle-confirmed pipe with BOTH nearby C2 context and live RIP/EIP execution
  Confidence  high
  Score       3/3  (handle-anchored; bare pipe strings are unscored leads)
  Coverage    PARTIAL — 1 region(s) short-read
  Review      high

  KEY SIGNALS

  Handle-confirmed pipe corroborated by memory evidence  [HIGH]  DETECTION  (pipe.corroboration)
    Inference   : 1 open pipe handle(s) are corroborated by C2-style context and/or live RIP/EIP
                  execution within ±4096 bytes of a matching pipe-name string's own address.
    Confidence  : high — Combines an OS-confirmed open handle with BOTH independent memory signals
                  (C2 artifacts AND live execution), both within 4096 bytes of that pipe's name
                  string — the strongest correlation this hunter can produce.
    Facts:
      - Handle=0x88 ObjectName=\Device\NamedPipe\msagent_1337 pipe_va=0x0000000001230101
        File_offset=(not captured) Region=0x0000000001230000 protect=PAGE_EXECUTE_READ
      - ↳ c2_va=0x0000000001230116 c2_match='http://' distance=0x15 same_page=True
      - ↳ c2_va=0x000000000123011d c2_match='198.51.100.7:8080' distance=0x1c same_page=True
      - ↳ c2_va=0x000000000123012f c2_match='submit.php' distance=0x2e same_page=True
      - ↳ live_rip=TID:0x999@RIP=0x0000000001230105 distance=0x4 same_page=True
    Limitations:
      - Name correlation between a handle's ObjectName and a string scan hit uses exact match on the
        canonicalized pipe name (prefix stripped, casefolded) — still not a cryptographic guarantee
        both refer to the identical kernel object if the process has multiple same-named pipe
        instances.
      - Proximity window is ±4096 bytes, not a proof of logical association — an unrelated string or
        thread could coincidentally fall within that window in a dense region.

  Known C2 framework pipe naming convention on an open handle  [MEDIUM]  DETECTION  (pipe.handle_framework_match)
    Inference   : 1 open pipe handle(s) match a known C2/lateral-movement framework naming
                  convention.
    Confidence  : medium — An OS-confirmed open handle (not just a string sitting in memory) whose
                  name matches a specific, narrow framework convention (e.g. Cobalt Strike's
                  msagent_/postex_ or PsExec's psexesvc) is meaningfully unlikely to be coincidental
                  — raised to HIGH only when further corroborated (see pipe.corroboration below).
    Facts:
      - Handle=0x88 ObjectName=\Device\NamedPipe\msagent_1337 framework=Cobalt Strike technique=SMB
        Beacon peer-to-peer pipe — default msagent pipe name mitre=T1090.001
    Limitations:
      - Framework pipe-name conventions can be renamed/customized by an operator; absence of a match
        does not mean absence of C2.

  Open pipe handles (HandleDataStream)  [MEDIUM]  OBSERVATION  (pipe.open_handles)
    Inference   : Process holds 1 open handle(s) to named pipe object(s), per HandleDataStream.
    Confidence  : medium — HandleDataStream is the OS's own record of what this process actually has
                  open — far stronger than a bare string match, but having ANY pipe handle open is
                  completely ordinary for most Windows processes (IPC, RPC, print spooler, etc.);
                  only a handle whose name matches a known C2/lateral-movement framework convention,
                  or one corroborated by nearby C2 context / active execution, is treated as a
                  detection.
    Facts:
      - Handle=0x88 ObjectName=\Device\NamedPipe\msagent_1337 canonical='msagent_1337' TypeName=File
        GrantedAccess=0x12019f [framework=Cobalt Strike]
    Limitations:
      - Presence of a pipe handle is not inherently suspicious.

  Pipe name strings in non-system memory  [LOW]  LEAD  (pipe.string_scan_lead)
    Inference   : 1 occurrence(s) of a '\pipe\' name found in non-system-DLL memory via byte-pattern
                  scan.
    Confidence  : low — A string match proves only that these bytes exist somewhere in memory — not
                  that any handle was ever opened by that name, nor that the name isn't
                  leftover/freed heap data or an unrelated buffer. Reported as a lead for the
                  analyst and to locate regions for C2-context/execution correlation; does NOT
                  contribute to the pipe score on its own.
    Facts:
      - VA=0x0000000001230101 File_offset=(not captured) name='\\.\\pipe\\msagent_1337'
        canonical='msagent_1337' Region=0x0000000001230000 size=0x1000 region_type=MEM_PRIVATE
        protect=PAGE_EXECUTE_READ encoding=ascii original_length=20 truncated=False
        sha256=d6c2e70f9c9c3c0846775370930f27816544963d398f55aa7d0aa43b0255f06d
    Limitations:
      - Every one of these 1 occurrence(s) shares a canonical name with an open handle reported
        above (see pipe.open_handles/pipe.handle_framework_match/pipe.corroboration) — the string
        match itself is still not scored; see those checks for the scored handle evidence.

  EVIDENCE DETAIL

  1 framework naming-convention match(es) on string leads — attribution only, never scored:
      Pipe: \.\pipe\msagent_1337 Region=0x0000000001230000 (this name also has an open handle — see
      pipe.open_handles/pipe.handle_framework_match/pipe.corroboration above)
        Framework: Cobalt Strike — SMB Beacon peer-to-peer pipe — default msagent pipe name
        [T1090.001]

  1 region(s) with a pipe-name string + C2 artifacts:
      Region 0x0000000001230000 pipe: \.\pipe\msagent_1337 (this name also has an open handle — see
      pipe.open_handles/pipe.corroboration above)
        C2: http:// VA 0x0000000001230116
        C2: 198.51.100.7:8080 VA 0x000000000123011d
        C2: submit.php VA 0x000000000123012f

  1 unbacked thread(s) starting in a pipe-name-string region — lead only, never scored:
      TID=0x999 StartAddr=0x0000000001230010 Region=0x0000000001230000

  COVERAGE

  [~] PARTIAL
      1 region(s) returned fewer bytes than declared (short read) — not fully scanned:
      0x0000000001230000 (4 KB)
      Impact: A pipe name or C2 artifact in memory that was never read cannot be ruled out —
      targeted follow-up needed on the region(s) above: --extract / --strings that VA, or re-scan it
      with an external scanner.
      Impact: Coverage incomplete despite a detection — additional pipe channels may exist beyond
      what could be checked.
